method: Independent numerical and analytic model checks, not renderer assertions.

checks.claim: Sixteen-tooth to thirty-two-tooth external gears have opposite angular speed with ratio minus one half.
One full large rotation corresponds to two full small rotations.
Pitch radii .9 and 1.8 use the same module.

limitations: Tooth outlines are schematic, with no undercut/fillet or contact-stress simulation. Exact rotation ratio is conditional on proper gear engagement.
